title: Skyblock Infinite: Skybound Spelunking Addon
description: A Simple Ore Crafting Addon Mainly For Skyblock Infinite but can be used for other things!

## What is This?
A Simple Ore Crafting Addon That I Had Mainly Put Together For Use In [Skyblock Infinite - Made By DrTrog](https://modrinth.com/datapack/skyblock-infinite) Due To There Being No Way For The Players To Get Ore Blocks If They Wanted To Have A Balanced Renewable Source To Them Without Cheats. but can be used for other things!

## What Does It Do?
Allows The Player To Craft Ores Using The Recipes Added Based On Discussions In [The SkyBlock Infinite Discord](https://discord.gg/cxkP79kPMz).

## Can I Add New Ores?
Yes, And I Encourage Sharing The Recipe Files You Make To [Here In The Infinite Skyblock Discord](https://discord.com/channels/965040027941867540/1289048439081930804) For The Community
- Here's How To Add Recipes:
  1. Go to [Misode's Data Pack Generator](https://misode.github.io/)
  2. Select Any Generator (Recipe Generator Is Easiest Starting Reference Point)
  3. Click The Three Dots And Select New Project
  4. Import This Pack's Zip Before You Press Create
  5. Click Recipe Generator
  6. Fill Out The ItemID's Of What Materials You Want To Use And What You Are Trying Make As Your Desired Output
  7. Name And Save The Recipe (These Files Will Be What You End Up Sharing By The Way.)
  8. Repeat 5 - 7 For Each Additionly Recipe
  9. Once Happy With Additions Go Ahead And Download
  10. Use The Revised Pack And Enjoy!

## Change Ores Recipes To Something Easier?
Yes, But As They Were Already Balanced For Skyblock And The Vanilla Ore Yield Ratio To Stop Players From Printing Infinite Ores From Only A Few Crafts... With That In Mind Not Sure You'll Need To Change It Unless You Don't Care About Balanced Returns, But...
- Here's How To Change Recipes:
  1. Go to [Misode's Data Pack Generator](https://misode.github.io/)
  2. Select Any Generator (Recipe Generator Is Easiest Starting Reference Point)
  3. Click The Three Dots And Select New Project
  4. Import This Pack's Zip Before You Press Create
  5. Now Select The Recipe You Want to Change
  6. Change Out The ItemID's Of What Materials You Want To Use To Craft The Ores
  7. Once Happy Download The Revised Version
  8. Use The Revised Pack And Enjoy... But Beware Possible Chaos That Can Ensue From Cheaper Ores In Multiplayer Worlds.

## How Do I Use/Install This Pack?
- Step 1: Open The Folder For The World You Want This Added To Or Make A New World With All The Packs You Want To Use Along With This One (Note: Don't Unzip Packs Unless Needed Or Instructed To Do So... Most Of The Time The Folders Are There For Compatability Not Extractions)
- Step 2: Add Pack To The Datapack Folder Of Your World
- Step 3:
  - Existing Worlds: 
    - With Cheats On (Or By Enabling LAN Sharing Cheats) Do `/datapack list available` To Allow The Name To Appear
    - Do `/datapack enable <"This Pack's Current Version Name From The Prior Command"> last` So It Loads After Everything Prior To Avoid Any Other Pack Overwrites
    - Run `/reload` Wait For It To Finish Loading
    -  Enjoy Access To Ore Crafting 
  - New Worlds:
    - Set The Pack To Load After Everthing Else At/Near The Top Of The Datapack Menu's List
    - Create World
    - Enjoy Access To Ore Crafting

## Crediting?
Honestly, Doesn't Bother Me If People Share Or Modify This Datapack But If Using As A Template To Your Own Pack Some Sort Of Crediting To Any Inspiration And/Or Any Files Used Initailly From This Pack Would Be Greatly Appreciated! (Licenses Are Confusing, lol)
